title: Business scope
intro: The business scope is the list of activities the company is registered to carry on, as recorded on its business license. For readability, the general business items are grouped by area of trade.
qualifier: Except for projects that require approval under the law, the company carries on business activities independently, in accordance with the law, on the strength of its business license.
translationNote: The English wording of the scope items is an unofficial translation provided for readability. The Chinese text printed on the business license is authoritative.
regulatedNote: Trade in some of these goods requires licenses, filings or approvals under applicable law. The registered scope is not a statement that any such license, filing or approval is held.

trade-services.name: Trade & agency services
trade-services.description: Trade agency, import and export of goods, and internet sales of goods that do not require a license to sell.
